I improved `0.html`:

- Gave it a real page title instead of the raw ID
- Added a visible fill color (blue) to the circle, since it was previously unstyled and effectively invisible against a white background
- Made the SVG responsive with `min(400px, 80vw)` so it scales on small screens
- Slightly reduced the radius (195 vs 200) so the circle isn't clipped at the SVG edges
- Added a light background and `role="img"`/`aria-label` for basic accessibility
